entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's not broken or anything. It just... it chafed my leg, and I really didn't find the data useful for my training. I was really counting on this, and to be honest, I really need the money back right now.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I have the order number please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 28 days ago. Unfortunately, it seems it might be too late to process a return. Our updated policy on wearable items is very strict due to hygiene and sanitation concerns once the device has been worn.

Oh. No, are you serious? I... I had no idea the policy was like that. That's really devastating. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I was hoping for some understanding. This puts me in a really tough spot.
I understand your frustration, and I do appreciate your loyalty. Please hold on for just a moment while I review the specific product details. I want to make absolutely sure.

Thank you for waiting. Okay, I have good news. I seem to have made a mistake, and I sincerely apologize for the confusion. The strict sanitation policy I mentioned only applies to our new line of heart-rate monitors.
Yes, absolutely. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. You are well within the window for a full refund. Again, my apologies for that incorrect information.
Oh, thank goodness! Wow, that is such a relief. Thank you so much for checking that, Alex. You have no idea what a help that is.

Of course, I'm happy I could clear that up. I'm processing the return now and have just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just place the item back in its box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
That's fantastic. Thank you again, you've really helped me out today.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
